name: Type Of Identification 4 Code
definition: Specifies the type of alternate identification which can be used to give an alternate identification of the party identified.

ARNU.name: Alien Registration Number
ARNU.definition: Number assigned by a government agency to identify foreign nationals.

CUST.name: Concat
CUST.definition: Number assigned by an issuer to identify a customer via the concatenation of the birthdate and characters of the first name and surname.

CORP.name: Corporate Identification
CORP.definition: Number assigned to a corporate entity.

DRLC.name: Driver License Number
DRLC.definition: Number assigned to a driver's license.

IDCD.name: Identity Card Number
IDCD.definition: Number assigned by a national authority to an identity card.

NRIN.name: National Registration Identification Number
NRIN.definition: National registration identification number. In Singapore this is known as the NRIC.

CCPT.name: Passport Number
CCPT.definition: Number assigned by a passport authority.

SOCS.name: Social Security Number
SOCS.definition: Number assigned by a social security agency.

TXID.name: Tax Identification Number
TXID.definition: Number assigned by a tax authority to an entity.
